adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar is initialized to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events it does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. Because `evt.destinationCalendar` can be `null`, the optional chaining causes a silent no-op and the collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are never added, dropping team members’ destination calendars without error.
